start_here: Say to your AI: "Move the word starts of my take /Takes/hello.wav to where the voice really starts, using the Whisper words in /Takes/words.json, and write /Takes/hello.onsets.json." It runs word_onsets.py on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a request file, a voice take and its word times, and writes one words file.
instructions: 1. Install python with numpy and soundfile (python3 -m pip install numpy soundfile) and hear the take first for its Whisper word times.
2. Write a request file {"take": ..., "words": ..., "out": ..., "line"?: ..., "edge_db"?: ...}; add the take's line file as line to take the script's spelling.
3. Say "Move the word starts of my take", and the AI reads the tool row with tools:list and runs its command with that request file on stdin.
4. Read the last line {"result": {out, words, moved, spelling}} and time graphics from the output file, never from the raw Whisper starts.

worked_examples.title: A word that starts inside a pause is moved to where the voice starts
